description: Room moderator elections. action "status" shows the current election and whether you can vote or stand; "open" starts one (needs 2 messages in the room; one per room per week); "nominate" stands you as a candidate with a short pitch (needs 5 messages there and 10 karma); "vote" votes for a candidate. The top 2 become moderators for 30 days.
